acceptance: The test (and any sibling fixed with it) passes 50 consecutive runs locally with random test ordering (command and result in the PR).
The tolerance is relative 1e-12 or tighter.
description:
## Problem
tests/unit/core/clickbench/test_clickbench_dataframe_execution.py::TestClickBenchQueryExecution::test_q4_average_user_id asserts `[4.350909328996494e16]` exactly. On 2026-11-24 it got 4.350909328996495e16 once in pr-preflight and passed on rerun: summation order changes the last digit.

## Change
Compare with pytest.approx at a relative tolerance no looser than 1e-12. Check the other ClickBench DataFrame tests for exact float comparisons of aggregates and fix the same way.

Guardrails: work in a linked worktree (make worktree-create), never the primary clone; heavy test runs only through lock-taking entry points; never set BENCHBOX_SKIP_TEST_LOCK or force admission; stage explicit paths; add a changelog.d fragment if users can see the change; no explanatory comments (make comment-policy-check). Do not round or change product query code.
